annotations.note: Epistolary novel. Real preface (narrative, 3rd-person 'Sybil Van Antwerp carries the mug of tea…', offset 2454) precedes the letters. DETECTOR mis-types [2107–28955] as one 'preface' block — swallowing the real preface + the dedication ('To Mark, with love') + a Joan Didion epigraph + the first ~25 letters; body then runs as one undetected block → COARSE. Embedded documents (newspaper clippings, ship manifest) are in-narrative content, not masked apparatus.
